about_the_game:
Gameplay

This is a relaxing game about building cozy settlements right inside dreams. Create unique villages and towns on various surreal platforms, enjoying simple gameplay and a calming atmosphere.

Two Modes

  • An engaging story mode (strategy/puzzle), where you dive into the dreams of different characters, and even help them overcome their nightmares![/]
  • A free-build mode where your creativity has no limits.[/]

Unique Atmosphere

The game features a distinctive hand-drawn black-and-white art style, inspired by cozy book illustrations and the aesthetics of handcrafted drawings. You can save your completed settlements and even print them out, turning them into coloring pages for relaxation and creativity (provided you have a printer).
Embark on a journey through limitless dream worlds, creating islands of peace and comfort!

short_description: Build cozy settlements in dreams! Solve relaxing puzzles by placing buildings on whimsical and surreal platforms. Explore unique worlds, immerse yourself in strangers' dreams, and enjoy the charm of hand-drawn visuals.
